messages.content: Compute the requested quantities. Return only one JSON object with the requested keys.

Prices changed from 100 to 110. Cash is 10000, shares 100, last price 110. Per-round cash interest rate is 0.0002; dividend is 0.02 per share. A limit buy costs at most 104 per share with no tax or other fees. Compute price_change_pct, interest_income, dividend_income, maximum_affordable_shares (whole shares).
